subject: Competition snapshot & validation rundown
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@fasthealth.com>, Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@vertexhealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-17T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Competition snapshot & validation rundown

Hi Maria / Ethan —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone (internal + external) has the same understanding and clear next steps. I kept this intentionally short.

1) Primary pain & goals we heard
- Pain: production latency spikes on long-context summarization flows (up to 1.2s/token under load) and brittle hallucination on clinical-note extraction.
- Goal: parity vs current vendor on precision/recall for extraction, reduce 99th percentile inference latency by ~30% at target throughput, and get audit logs/SOC2 evidence for security review.

2) Decision criteria (ranked by FastHealth during call)
- Latency and stable P99 under sustained traffic (top)
- Extraction quality on customer prompt set (factuality + structured output)
- Operational controls: KMS integration, audit logs, VPC/private deployment options
- Unit economics at scale (token cost +/- dedicated pricing)

3) Competitive snapshot we discussed
- Vendor X: strong accuracy, but inconsistent P99 under concurrent sessions per your bench; limited KV-cache controls.
- Vendor Y: cheaper at token-level but requires significant engineering for reliable batching and does not offer RBAC-backed audit streams out of the box.

4) Proposed validation tests (what Redwood will run / what we need from you)
- Redwood will: run a head-to-head 24-hour soak with a 50k-token synthetic replay of your busiest workflows + a focused extraction accuracy test (100 labeled cases) and collect latency/throughput/cost metrics.
- We need from FastHealth: a ~500-record sample of de-identified notes, the canonical extraction label set (CSV), and a short list of 5 high-sensitivity queries to ensure we test hallucination risk.

5) Timeline & ask
- Target: run validation next week (Mon–Wed). Preliminary scorecard back by Thu.
- Please confirm: (a) willingness to share the de-identified sample, (b) SOC2 evidence requested (we can share our portal), and (c) primary purchasing contact for procurement questions.

Attachments: fasthealth-bakeoff-scorecard.xlsx (template) and redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (what we run during the PoC).

If that aligns, I’ll schedule a kickoff test window and assign Marcus to run the soak.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Can Redwood do the following for Monday?
- Run a focused 30-minute live replay against a small subset (we can provide ~200 de-identified notes by EOD Sunday) to show baseline P50/P90/P99 and a small accuracy sweep.
- Share the SOC2 report link and a short note on how request-level logging and retention are configurable in Redwood Private.
- Include a short pricing sketch for Dedicated (monthly committed capacity) and a ballpark for burst credits.

If you can confirm those three items I’ll flag procurement and our security lead (Ethan) so they can prepare for a short checklist review.
